findings.finding: Python depth-64 boundary diverged from JavaScript.
findings.resolution: Python now rejects depth 64; deterministic parity oracles cover depths 63, 64, and 65.

findings.finding: Python classified NaN and Infinity differently from JavaScript.
findings.resolution: Both classify non-finite JSON constants as MALFORMED_JSON; regression oracles cover NaN and Infinity.

findings.finding: Invalid host strings containing unpaired surrogates diverged.
findings.resolution: Both implementations reject invalid scalar strings as INVALID_UNICODE before UTF-8 conversion.

findings.finding: Exact replay equality depended on SHA-256 operation digests.
findings.resolution: Both reducers compare retained canonical operation strings exactly.

implementation_review.closure: No important regression introduced by the fixes was found in static review.

findings.finding: A self-derived generator could overwrite the golden corpus.
findings.resolution: The generator was removed; the checked-in expected projections are frozen independent targets.

findings.finding: Declared limits lacked complete inclusive-accept and exclusive-reject parity oracles.
findings.resolution: Cross-language controls now cover byte size, depth, safe integers, labels, fields, notes, note bodies, and operation count.

findings.finding: Finality could be misread as broader lifecycle finality.
findings.resolution: Contract and README limit finality to mutation of the modeled object and enumerate excluded lifecycle claims.

corpus_review.closure: Frozen expectations, declared limits, and object-only finality are resolved.

acceptance_basis: Reviewer closure plus post-fix focused, differential, fuzz, build, typecheck, and 891-test repository acceptance.
authority_boundary: Technical PASS-AS-HELD only. No merge, push, publication, deployment, activation, or live-client verdict.
